kind: Measured deployed Worker/R2 observations plus separately labeled local simulations

raw.kind: Measured Worker R2 binding; headers/body timings exclude client-to-Worker network; cache state of R2 itself is unknown

notes: Scenario-balanced hand-authored workload, not user logs or traffic-weighted SLO.
Local process CPU/RSS aggregate 67 logical Workers; not measured Cloudflare CPU or isolate memory.
Production root trace counts root R2 only; local traces include leaf R2 too.
Reset means application caches cleared in a loaded graph; R2/backend/isolate cold state is not forced.
P95 over 16 queries is the maximum sample; tail estimates have limited statistical power.
Active bulk import and this machine were not isolated from background work.
